obligation.exact_statement: Prove or correct exact finite-grid count recovery and fully charged simplex readout as a strong comparator within D1-D7: for known M and h-grid a with |a-C/M|<1/(2M), implement nearest count by floor((2M A+Q)/(2Q)), A=Qa,Q=2^h, with legal Boolean/ReLU gates, closed-grid endpoint and all word/range/hold costs. Apply it to a paid K^3-feature uniform-count head (nominal Q>=2M, retaining finite evaluator h>=4) and separately to the admitted C1 D3 recovered joint frequency whose nominal error is <=76/Q (sufficient Q>=256M), followed by exact integer add-one and dyadic simplex output. Prove pathwise bitwise equality of these two strengthened comparators at the same sufficient Q and TV error <=(K-1)/Q; state their restricted correlated post-aggregation perturbation margins and where the rounding guarantee ceases. Give full resource functions/deltas including known length, feature tables, finite attention, integer count snapping and output, and distinguish sufficient precision schedules from precision lower bounds or componentwise budget dominance. Treat D3-snap as an explicitly charged alternative readout, leaving the accepted Pi_(N,h) and its C3 experiment unchanged. Use C1 only through admitted Fact b2f4d10fa0a69e00; no free counts, table, floor oracle, all-decoder lower bound or novelty presumption.

assumptions: D1-D8 are the exact current stage scope; theta is unknown and no parameter depends on the test law.
Stationary strictly positive second-order sources; uniform finite-N claims explicitly declare their additional class bounds.
All side information, positions, endpoint access, finite arithmetic, residuals and program/parameter storage are charged.
Binary product kernels map to the earlier sign-B kernel as inD2; categorical extension and complete-contextA stay distinct.
Copied prior material is provenance and must undergo this project native evidence path when used as an admitted premise.
